verdict.rationale: The evidence says the 01 server 'runs on your computer' and that the language model can be changed via profiles. Neither documents any control over where user data is stored, nor any region or residency choice. Local execution is an architectural trait rather than a residency feature, and the optional OpenAI Realtime API path sends data to a third party with no documented residency terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
